title: On Applauding the youngest singer
subtitle: 戏剧表演 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 戏剧表演（文学艺术与体育·戏剧与表演）
meta: 主题语境：戏剧表演（文学艺术与体育·戏剧与表演）　|　核心词汇：applaud　|　正文 323 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 applaud 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the operator ① applauded the youngest singer without complaint, and every trainee in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three shifts on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the operator ② applauds the youngest singer with great care without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ applaud the youngest singer at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ applauded the youngest singer before — a line in the log for June 1969 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Applauding the youngest singer without complaint, the operator said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the switch at the far screen, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ applaud the decision to wait with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Applaud the decision to wait at once and never mention it again.

By 1982 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the log, and a new trainee from the next station ⑧ applauds the decision to wait without complaint every shift without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the screen, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ applauded the youngest singer again when nobody else would.

⑩ To applaud the youngest singer, my mother said in 1987, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the station remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the station forgets, somebody applauds the youngest singer with great care again and somebody must applaud the youngest singer without complaint all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 为…鼓掌（一般过去式 applauded the youngest singer：1975 年操作员头一回这样做，毫无怨言地）
B. v. 为…鼓掌（一般现在 applauds the youngest singer：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 为…鼓掌（不定式 to applaud the youngest singer：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 为…鼓掌（过去完成时 had applauded the youngest singer：1969 年六月的运行日志上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 为…鼓掌（动名词 applauding the youngest singer 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 称赞（applaud the decision to wait：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去称赞那个再等等的决定）
G. v. 称赞（applaud the decision to wait：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 为…鼓掌（后段两处：新来的实习生照例 applauds the decision to wait，而母亲又一次 applauded the youngest singer）

items.q: applaud the decision to wait with great care
applaud the decision to wait at once
applauds the decision to wait without complaint

answers.why: applaud 意为“为…鼓掌”，1975 年操作员毫无怨言地为…鼓掌最小的那位歌手，那是机房里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 applauded。
applaud 意为“为…鼓掌”，自那以后操作员小心翼翼地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 applauds。
applaud 意为“为…鼓掌”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯为…鼓掌最小的那位歌手”，此处为不定式 to applaud the youngest singer。
applaud 意为“为…鼓掌”，运行日志里 六月 那行字说明早在 1982 年之前就有人为…鼓掌过，故用过去完成时 had applauded。
applaud 意为“为…鼓掌”，操作员说“为…鼓掌最小的那位歌手这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 applauding the youngest singer 作主语。
applaud 意为“称赞”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去称赞那个再等等的决定”，should ever 之后用原形 applaud the decision to wait。
applaud 意为“称赞”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻称赞那个再等等的决定（applaud the decision to wait at once），以后再也不要提起。
applaud 意为“为…鼓掌”，新来的实习生每个班次都照例称赞那个再等等的决定，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 applauds。
applaud 意为“为…鼓掌”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次毫无怨言地为…鼓掌最小的那位歌手，用一般过去式 applauded 叙述。
applaud 意为“为…鼓掌”，结尾那句是母亲 1987 年的话：要为…鼓掌最小的那位歌手，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和机房记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1975 年，操作员毫无怨言地为…鼓掌最小的那位歌手；机房里每一个实习生都说这是头一回。（applauded the youngest singer）
多年以后，操作员仍小心翼翼地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（applauds the youngest singer）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯为…鼓掌最小的那位歌手这件事本身。（to applaud the youngest singer）
早在 1969 年就有人为…鼓掌最小的那位歌手，六月那天运行日志上的一行字就是证据。（had applauded the youngest singer）
操作员说过，毫无怨言地为…鼓掌最小的那位歌手这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（applauding the youngest singer 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻称赞那个再等等的决定，以后再也不要提起。（applaud the decision to wait，祈使句）
answers: In 1975 the operator applauded the youngest singer without complaint, and every trainee in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three shifts on, the operator still applauds the youngest singer with great care without being asked.
My mother said later that to applaud the youngest singer at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had applauded the youngest singer long before 1982, and the line in the log for June proves it.
Applauding the youngest singer without complaint, the operator said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Applaud the decision to wait at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 applaud 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1975 the operator applauded the youngest singer without complaint, and nobody in the station forgot it.
Even now the operator applauds the youngest singer with great care whenever the station asks.
Applauding the youngest singer without complaint, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever applaud the decision to wait with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new trainee from the next station applauds the decision to wait without complaint every shift, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother applauded the youngest singer again, and the station remembered that half.
